brief:
Iranian protesters set fire to a giant banner depicting US President Donald Trump, Vice President JD Vance, and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu at a rally in Tehran, Al Jazeera English reported. The demonstration reflected tensions between Iran and the incoming US administration as well as ongoing hostilities with Israel.

Details of the rally's broader context or stated aims were not immediately available.
dek: A giant banner depicting US President Donald Trump and Israel’s Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu was burnt in Tehran…
title: Iranian protesters burn banner of Trump, Netanyahu, and Vance at Tehran rally
